title: Camera restored and menu fade rebuilt
details: The photo and video camera routes are restored and no longer touched by menu animation code
Photo and video prompts, Next prompt, timestamps and saving remain unchanged

No cloned screens, click interception or evidence-overlay observers are used
summary: Evia v145 restores the working cameras and moves menu fading into the correct core render path.
changes: Core fade out and fade in
